title: Pelica Translate: AI Web & Video Translator, Write with AI - Chrome Web Store
excerpt: With the Pelica extension, you can: - Translate sections on the go - Translate entire pages - Translate YouTube videos
content_html:
Overview

With the Pelica extension, you can: - Translate sections on the go - Translate entire pages - Translate YouTube videos

Translate websites, YouTube videos, images, and text with AI. Read and write across languages without leaving your browser. Pelica is an AI translation Chrome extension built for the way you actually use the web. Translate entire web pages, watch YouTube videos with translated subtitles, translate text inside images, or write in your own language and turn it into natural English instantly. Instead of constantly copying text, opening another translator, pasting it, translating it, and coming back, Pelica brings translation directly into the page you're already using. Whether you're reading Reddit, searching Google, watching YouTube, talking with ChatGPT, reading news from another country, or writing a message in English, Pelica helps you understand and communicate without breaking your flow. Pelica works with leading AI models including ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), and Gemini, giving you natural, context-aware translations for everyday browsing and communication. Read. Watch. Write. Translate. One extension for using the web in any language. —— Key Features: ✅ Translate entire websites and web pages Translate foreign-language websites directly in your browser without copying and pasting text into another translation service. Use Pelica for news, blogs, documentation, search results, Reddit, social media, and other websites you visit every day. ✅ Translate text as you browse Select text on a web page and translate it instantly. Quickly understand a sentence, paragraph, comment, or phrase without leaving the page you're reading. ✅ Translate YouTube videos with bilingual subtitles Watch YouTube videos in other languages with translated subtitles. See the original subtitles together with the translation so you can understand what is being said while keeping the original language available for context. Use it for interviews, tutorials, podcasts, entertainment, lectures, product reviews, and videos from creators around the world. ✅ Translate images with AI Translate text inside images directly from your browser. Pelica can recognize text in images and translate it, making it easier to understand screenshots, advertisements, menus, social media posts, comics, infographics, and other visual content. No need to manually type the text you see in an image. ✅ Translate while you write Write in your own language and translate your message into another language directly where you're typing. Use Pelica in text boxes across the web to write emails, search queries, social media posts, comments, messages, and prompts without repeatedly switching between your browser and a translation app. Write what you want to say first. Pelica helps you say it in another language. ✅ Write natural English with AI Translation is not always enough. Pelica can help turn what you want to say into natural English that fits the context, rather than simply translating each word literally. Use AI writing assistance when replying to someone, writing a post, sending a message, searching in English, or communicating with people around the world. ✅ AI-powered translation Pelica uses leading AI models and language models including ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), and Gemini. AI translation can understand more of the surrounding context, helping produce natural translations for conversations, articles, videos, and everyday communication. —— Translate the Web Without Breaking Your Flow A lot of translation still works like this: Copy the text. Open a translation tool. Paste it. Translate it. Copy the result. Go back to the original page. It works, but doing it dozens of times a day gets frustrating. Pelica is designed to remove those extra steps. Translation happens where you're already reading, watching, or writing, so you can stay focused on what you're actually doing. —— Use Pelica Across the Web Pelica is useful anywhere language gets in the way. ### Reading websites Read articles, blogs, documentation, forums, and websites written in other languages. Translate the whole page or just the part you need. ### Browsing Reddit and social media Understand posts, comments, discussions, and communities from around the world without constantly opening a separate translator. ### Searching in another language Write what you want to search for in your own language and translate it before searching. This makes it easier to discover information that may not exist in your native language. ### Using ChatGPT and other AI tools Write prompts in your native language and translate them directly inside the input box. You can also translate responses and other content while staying on the same page. ### Watching YouTube Watch videos from creators around the world with translated subtitles while keeping the original subtitles visible for context. ### Reading text inside images Translate screenshots, graphics, social media images, advertisements, and other images containing text. ### Writing emails and messages Write what you actually want to say first, then translate it into natural English or another language before sending it. —— Why Pelica? The internet is global, but language still changes what you can access. Some of the best discussions are on Reddit. Some of the best videos are on YouTube. Some of the best articles, communities, products, and ideas may never be published in your language. Pelica is built to make those language differences matter less. Instead of treating translation as a separate task, Pelica makes it part of browsing itself. - Read websites in other languages - Translate web pages without switching tabs - Watch YouTube with translated subtitles - Translate text inside images - Translate selected text instantly - Write in your own language and communicate globally - Use AI to create more natural translations - Access information that would otherwise be difficult to find —— Built for Reading and Writing Most translation tools focus on one direction: understanding something someone else wrote. But using the global internet also means writing. You might want to reply to a Reddit post. Ask a question in an international community. Search Google in English. Write a prompt for ChatGPT. Send a message to someone overseas. Post something for a global audience. Pelica is built for both sides. Translate what you read. Translate what you write. —— How to Use Pelica ### Add Pelica to Chrome - Click “Add to Chrome” - Open Pelica from your browser extension menu - Choose your preferred language ### Translate a Website - Open the web page you want to read - Start Pelica - Translate the page into your preferred language ### Translate Selected Text - Select the text you want to understand - Open Pelica's translation - Read the translation without leaving the page ### Translate YouTube Videos - Open a YouTube video - Turn on subtitles - Use Pelica to display translated subtitles ### Translate an Image - Choose an image containing text - Use Pelica's image translation - Read the translated content ### Translate While Writing - Type what you want to say in your own language - Use Pelica directly from the input box - Turn it into natural text in your target language - Keep writing without switching tabs —— Powered by AI Pelica supports AI-powered translation using leading models including: - ChatGPT by OpenAI - Claude by Anthropic - Gemini by Google Different language models have different strengths, and Pelica is designed to make modern AI translation available directly inside your everyday browser experience. —— Made for People Who Use the Global Internet Pelica is useful for: * People learning or working in another language * Students and researchers reading international sources * Developers reading foreign documentation and discussions * People using Reddit and international online communities * YouTube viewers watching creators from other countries * Travelers reading local websites and information * Professionals communicating with international teams * Creators reaching audiences around the world * Anyone who regularly copies text into a translator just to understand the web —— One Browser. Any Language. You shouldn't have to choose what you can read, watch, or say based on the language it was written in. Pelica brings AI translation directly into your browser so you can explore more of the internet without constantly thinking about translation. Translate websites. Translate YouTube videos. Translate images. Translate text. Write across languages. Keep browsing. Pelica handles the language.
